title: The bus dash from Dallas for the Savoy-Golden Gate battle
summary: He drove 3,000 miles from Dallas to be at the Savoy for the Golden Gate opening.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit

blocks.x: Oh, we did quite a bit of, I jumped from Dallas, Texas just to play a special date in the Savoy Room, just in a bus, all the way back to New York. That's somewhere around 3,000 miles. The bus driver, I don't know how he made it. We just stopped over about 4 or 5 hours to rest for him.

The reason why I had to do that was the Golden Gate Ballroom up from the Savoy Ballroom was opening up on a certain date. Now, they got 5 bands going in there. Now, Tuxedo Junction at that time was very popular. Now, Savoy wanted

to battle that opening of the Golden Gate. I think they had Andy Kirk, Teddy Wilson, Coleman Hawkins, a couple other bands. I can't recall the names right now. And then, I had to get back so I could be there on opening night.
So, we had to jump all the way from Dallas, Texas and cut my tour short. You know, we had the battle of those two ballrooms.
And then everything made out all right.
